description: Enlargement of the existing basement including the formation of a rear lightwell. Erection of a single-storey rear infill extension with a part-glazed pitched roof and refurbishment of existing side garage including conversion to habitable room. Alteration to side fenestration. Erection of a rear and a side roof extension and installation of two front roof windows.
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered location plan, D01, D02, D03, D04, D05, D07, 25006-120-09, 25006-121-08, 25006-122-07, 25006-123-08, 25006-124-07, 25006-130-08, 25006-131-09, Design and Access & Heritage Statement, Daylight and Sunlight Report, Daylight and Sunlight Assessment letter from Vinay Kaura dated on 17 June 2026, Energy Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Flood map for planning, Fire Safety Statement, Basement Impact Plan, Local Biodiversity Checklists and Unnumbered photographs. Received: 03/07/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy

Condition : 5 - The basement hereby permitted shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
Reason: In order to ensure that adequate living standards are maintained and to protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 6 - The windows to be fitted on the front roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
Reason: In order to safeguard the architectural and historic interest of the conservation area.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until a Construction Method Statement (CMS) relating to the basement hereby approved has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority. The CMS shall be certified by a qualified professional and give details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area. The approved CMS shall be adhered to throughout the construction period for the development.
Reason: In order to protect the living conditions of neighbouring residents, to minimise flood risk and to ensure highway safety is maintained.
